title: Ed25519 deterministic signing ensures same article → identical CID across parallel POSTs
description: sign_article() signs with ed25519-dalek which uses RFC 8032 deterministic signing: same key + same bytes → same signature → same CID in IPFS every time. This is not an accident — it makes the IPFS write idempotent: if two concurrent sessions POST the same article, both sign to the same bytes, write to the same CID, and msgid_map.insert_or_ignore handles the second attempt cleanly. A future contributor might 'improve' this by adding a nonce or timestamp to the signature, which would break idempotency. Defend: Ed25519 is deterministic by spec (RFC 8032 §5.1.6); adding randomness is non-standard and actively harmful here.
